title: No flight disruptions despite job cuts—AirAsia PH

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — AirAsia Philippines reassured customers of uninterrupted flight services despite workforce cuts to manage the business impact of rising fuel costs and currency pressures. “AirAsia Philippines remains fully operational and committed to serving the Philippine market,” AirAsia Philippines General Manager and President Anna Victoria Lu said in a statement on Friday. READ: AirAsia slashes PH workforce “We want to assure our passengers that the announced workforce adjustment will not affect their flight, booking, or other services,” Lu added.
